facts.fact: Podium's pricing page says its plans are designed around each business's needs and that buyers should talk to the sales team for details; no plan price figures appear in this chunk.
facts.quote: Plans designed to fit your specific business needs, talk to our sales team for details.

facts.fact: Podium's pricing page states that HVAC businesses should contact sales for applicable pricing rather than using the listed plans.
facts.quote: HVAC businesses should contact sales for applicable pricing

facts.fact: Podium's own marketing claims that its AI Employee can help businesses get 30% more sales.
facts.quote: Get 30% _more_ sales with AI Employee, _even_ while you sleep.

facts.fact: Podium's pricing page lists 200+ integrations with integration support as a feature of its entry-level Core plan.
Podium's pricing page says a Phone Systems add-on is available, and that an Advanced Reporting add-on is available on its top tier.
Podium charges $5 per month for each phone number beyond those included in the plan.
Podium states that higher bulk message limits are available beyond the listed allowances.
Podium states a base 10DLC fee of $5 per month is charged for all US locations.
facts.quote: A base 10DLC fee of $5/month is charged for all US locations.

facts.fact: Podium Phones seats cost $25 per user per month for teams of 5 or more users.
Podium states that discounts are available on Phone Seats.
Podium charges a $500 network optimization fee per location for Podium Phones.
facts.quote: There is a $500 network optimization fee per location.

facts.fact: Podium states that pricing plans may vary based on industry, partnerships, integrations, volume, and carrier fees.
facts.quote: Please note that pricing plans may vary based on industry, partnerships, integrations, volume, and carrier fees.

facts.fact: Podium lists Contacts as unlimited in all three plan columns.
Podium lists Team Members as unlimited in all three plan columns.
Podium's pricing page lists its plans in USD per month, but the dollar amounts are not included in this page chunk.
Podium's Core plan is priced at $399 per month.
Podium's Pro plan is priced at $599 per month.
Podium's Signature plan is offered at custom pricing rather than a published price.
The Core plan includes 250 bulk message credits per month.
The Core plan includes 5 phone numbers.

facts.fact: High-Volume Carrier-Verified Messaging costs $15 per month on the Core plan, is included on the Pro plan, and is custom-priced on the Signature plan.
Podium Phones seats cost $30 per user per month for 1-4 users and $25 per user per month for 5+ users on the Core and Pro plans.
